models.name: New Rave
models.description: Our take on a classic Noserider. A very easy and forgiving ride. Molasses is the term that comes to mind.. Smooth and easy as she goes is what this is all about. Plenty of guts in this board with ample foil where needed to keep things sensitive and responsive. There's a bit going on but everything's pretty subtle and well tempered. If you have liked the Nausea and want something fresh it's a great update for a new feel. If you're after something for softer waves but more lively than your traditional nose rider, you'll be stoked on these.
